title_zh: 确认志愿者完成设备示范并约好复习

scenario.label_zh: 确认志愿者完成设备示范并约好复习
scenario.goal_zh: 依据实际示范确认指定操作已达要求，并约定下一班前复习检查清单

context_zh: 虚构社区活动培训：负责人刚看完志愿者使用不含危险操作的借书扫描设备。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: Have I finished the scanner check, or is there another test?

sentences.speaker: Trainer
sentences.text: That was the last one. You demonstrated the required competence in checking books in and out.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: I was worried about the coordination between scanning the card and watching the screen.

sentences.speaker: Trainer
sentences.text: You caught the duplicate scan and corrected it. I can sign you off as competent for this task.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: Thanks. Could I keep the checklist for my first shift?

sentences.speaker: Trainer
sentences.text: Of course. And let me congratulate you on completing the assessment.

sentences.speaker: Nico
sentences.text: I'll review the checklist before my shift tomorrow. I know who to ask if the screen shows something unfamiliar.
